title: 2nd Science/Social Studies Pacing Support
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Unit overview table, row S3 (What is Matter and How Does It Change?)] Nov 30 - Dec 18
[Unit overview table, row SS3 (Georgia’s First People)] Jan 4 - Feb 5
[Nov 30–Dec 4 weekly block, Week Focus] Phenomenon: Hot Spring. States of matter (ice, water, steam) and describing and classifying objects by physical properties; Boat, Kite, Balloon materials sort (S2P1.a).
[Jan 4–8 weekly block, Week Focus] Launch: who the Muscogee (Creek) and Cherokee are, then and now. Locate where they lived on a Georgia map (SS2G2.a, SS2G2.d). Students return Tuesday (4 days).
[Jan 4–8 weekly block, I Can] I can locate where the Muscogee (Creek) and Cherokee lived in Georgia and explain how they used their local resources.
[Jan 4–8 weekly block, Support / PEC] Teach that Muscogee (Creek) and Cherokee people still live in Georgia and the U.S. today; avoid language that suggests they no longer exist.
[Jan 25–29 weekly block, Week Focus] Sequoyah: his life, the Cherokee syllabary, and how he showed patience and overcame challenges (SS2H1.b, SS2CG3).
